usageNotes: Use this to define a custom role that groups one or more Proxmox privileges, which can then be assigned to users or groups via ACL entries. The caller must hold `Sys.Modify` on `/access`. The `privs` field accepts a comma-separated privilege list (e.g. `VM.PowerMgmt,VM.Console`); omitting it creates an empty role that can be populated later with `put_access_roles_{roleid}`.

examples.summary: Create a read-only VM monitoring role

tips: Role IDs must match the `pve-roleid` format: alphanumeric plus hyphens/underscores, no spaces.
Built-in roles (Administrator, PVEAdmin, etc.) cannot be overwritten; choose a unique roleid.
An empty role (no privs) is valid and useful as a placeholder before privileges are finalized.
After creation, assign the role to a user/group with `post_access_acl`.
